title: Roll out VCF Operations for Logs forwarder updates
prompt: Implement the unfinished VcfOpsLogs PowerShell module and its scenario runner in this repository. The module must expose Invoke-VcfOpsLogsForwarderRollout and use the pinned VCF Operations for Logs 9.0 contract in docs/contract.json. Authenticate with POST_sessions, then apply the supplied forwarder updates in order with PUT_log-forwarder-id. Build each update body from the contract: send the four required fields and include an optional field only when that field was actually supplied, preserving explicitly supplied false, zero, or empty values. Use the returned sessionId as a Bearer token. Stop after the first failed update, but return a structured report instead of throwing away progress. The report must contain OverallStatus, set to Succeeded or Failed, and a Steps array. Every attempted change in Steps must have exactly the properties OperationId, TargetId, Status, HttpStatus, ErrorCode, and Message. A successful earlier change must remain reported as successful when a later change fails. Complete scripts/Invoke-ForwarderRollout.ps1 so it reads scenario/forwarder-rollout.json, creates the credential, imports the supplied VcfOpsLogs.psd1 module manifest, invokes the module, and always writes the report JSON to the requested output path. If the runner terminates before any update can be attempted, it must still write a Failed report with an empty Steps array. Keep VMware.Sdk.Vcf.Ops as the module prerequisite; it is preinstalled by the environment and must not be vendored. Do not contact a live VMware endpoint. Validate the implementation with python3 -B tests/verify.py, which uses the provided loopback contract mock.
scenario: Authenticate once, apply forwarder updates in order, retain an earlier success when the next update fails, and do not attempt a later update after that failure.
constraint: The contract-pinned loopback request log proves exact request targets, Bearer authentication, optional-field omission and value preservation, and the partial-failure report.
